name: Keir
source:
"When I compliment you—if that ever happens—you'll know."

Where there is a market, there are thieves. Keir steals to feed hungry mouths, but never forget that to survive at the fringes requires the most ruthless kind of pragmatism.

(From [url=https://rottenraccoons.itch.io/obscura]itch.io[/url])

He is implied to be in his mid-thirties, according to [url=https://rottenraccoons.tumblr.com/post/700898711538139136/how-old-are-the-casts-or-the-rough-estimates-if]Tumblr[/url].
